decisions.decision: Special Event Policy: Lunenburg Business Association to compile feedback from business owners; Town Counsel to review legal defensibility of private-property provisions; Board to seek examples from other communities.
decisions.quote: the select board agreed on the following next steps: the lunenburg business association (via president joeci gilchrest) will compile feedback

decisions.decision: Special Event Policy: consensus that the ban on alcohol service on town property for special events should be reconsidered.
decisions.quote: the select board expressed consensus that this restriction should be reconsidered

decisions.decision: Letter to Governor Healey: Chair Nuzzolo to revise the letter and bring the revised draft to the December 16 meeting for final approval.
decisions.quote: the select board agreed that chair nuzzolo would revise the letter to incorporate the points raised

decisions.decision: Appointment Policy: agreed to explore a Microsoft Forms digital volunteer application option.
decisions.quote: the board agreed to explore the digital option.

decisions.decision: Appointment Policy: vacancies to be posted on the Town website and local cable television, with a social media post for each update, replacing newspaper and bulletin-board notices.
decisions.quote: going forward, vacancies should be posted on the town website

decisions.decision: Appointment Policy: appointments to be made during the month of June rather than at the first and second regular meetings in June.
decisions.quote: the board agreed to change the requirement that appointments be made at the

decisions.decision: Appointment Policy: interviews beyond the automatic trigger (more applicants than vacancies) require a vote of the Select Board as a body, with an articulated reason.
decisions.quote: should require a vote of the select board as a body, with an articulated reason.

decisions.decision: Appointment Policy: incumbent feedback to be submitted by individual members to the Town Manager's office and not discussed at a meeting of the applicable body.
decisions.quote: the board agreed that feedback should be submitted by individual members to the town manager's office

decisions.decision: Appointment Policy: Chair to compile the noted revisions and bring a draft updated policy back for Board review.
decisions.quote: the chair indicated he would compile all noted revisions and bring a draft updated policy back for board review.

decisions.decision: Select Board Bylaw: referred to Town Counsel for an opinion on whether it is necessary and why other communities keep similar bylaws.
decisions.quote: the select board agreed to refer the bylaw to town counsel for an opinion on whether it is necessary

decisions.decision: Tri-Board letter: the second paragraph reframed as working collaboratively to improve communication; redundant sentence removed; closing sentence by Member Moore substituted.
decisions.quote: after discussion, the select board agreed on three modifications

decisions.decision: Licenses: approve fully compliant applications outright on December 16, issue contingent approvals for the rest, and address non-responsive applicants individually.
decisions.quote: the best course of action is to approve fully compliant applications outright at the december 16 meeting

decisions.decision: Kids Kingdom: conceptual plans to be developed first, then a collaborative discussion with the School Committee; Facilities Director to prepare a low-cost conceptual sketch.
decisions.quote: facilities director ruth will prepare a low-cost conceptual sketch of a potential relocation scenario
